Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১) Who wrote the novel 'Tom Jones'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Henry Fielding is regarded as 'Father of English Novel' and his famous Novels are Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews, Jonathan Wilde, Top Secret.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২) Who is not the 'University Wits'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Elizabethan Period এর একদল Young dramatist and pamphleteers (ক্ষুদ্র পুস্তিকা রচয়িতা) দেরকে University Wits বলা হয়। তাঁরা Oxford and Cambridge University এর Scholar/Witty students ছিলেন। তাঁরা অনেক বিখ্যাত নাটক রচনা ও মঞ্চস্থ করার মাধ্যমে খ্যাতি অর্জন করেছিলেন। University Wits ছিলেন মোট ৭ জন। এঁরা হলেন- Christopher Marlowe, Thomas Kyd, Robert Greene, George Peele, Thomas Nashe, John Lyly and Thomas Lodge.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩) Who wrote the play 'The Silent Woman'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Ben Jonson Comedies are known as 'Comedy of Humors'. His famous writings are The Magnetic Lady, Volpone, Every Man Out of His Humour, Every Man in His Humour, The Silent Woman, The Alchemist, The Devil is an Ass etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪) Who is known as Wisest Fool?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
King James-1, known as the Wisest Fool, instituted the translation of the Bible into English in 1611. The Authorized King James Bible appeared in 1611 and its language became the benchmark of English language.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৫) Who wrote the poem 'The Good Morrow'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Donne is a Metaphysical Poet. He is called Poet of Love and Religious Poet.
His famous poems are The Good Morrow, The Flea, The Ecstasy, The Sun Rising, The Canonization, Twicknam Garden, For Whom The Bell Tolls etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৬) William Shakespeare died in-
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
William Shakespeare was an English dramatist. William Shakespeare was born on 23 April, 1564 AD and died on 23 April, 1616 AD. Birth place: Stratford Avon. '1590-1616' is called Shakespearean period.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৭) Who wrote the book 'Leviathan'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Thomas Hobbes is a political philosopher in the Commonwealth Period of English literature. His famous book is Leviathan.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৮) Which period is called 'The Golden age of English literature'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Elizabethan age is named after Queen Elizabeth I who reigned over England from 1558 to 1603. This is called the Golden age of English literature.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৯) Who is the greatest 'Cavalier Poet'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
The Greatest Cavalier poet is Robert Herrick. He is a famous poet of Caroline Period. His famous poets are To Daffodils, Delight in Disorder, The Night Piece of Julia, The Slitany to the Holy Spirit.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১০) Which is the earliest epic in English literature?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Beowulf is the Earliest Epic in English literature (England). It is also the first monument in English literature.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১১) Who wrote the book 'A Preface to Shakespeare'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Dr. Samuel Jonson is the Father of English dictionary. He is the first lexicographer in English. His famous books- A Preface to Shakespeare, Rasselas: Prince of Abissinia, Life of the English Poets etc. His famous poem is The Vanity of Human Wishes.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১২) Who wrote the Elegy 'Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Thomas Gray is famous for Graveyard Poet. His famous Elegy is 'Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard'.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১৩) Who wrote the book 'Hudibras'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Samuel Butler is the writer of the Restoration Period. His famous satire in verse is Hudibras.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১৪) Who is the Father of English Modern Poetry?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Geoffrey Chaucer is the Father of English Modern Poetry. His best writing is Canterbury Tales and Troilus and Criseyde. He is also called Father of English Language, Father of English literature, First Humourist in English Literature, The First great Modernist.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১৫) Who is called the Father of English prose?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Wycliffe is called the Father of English prose. He translated The Bible into English from Latin.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১৬) Who wrote the prose 'Morte d'Arthur'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Morte d'Arthur is the first romance in prose. The writer of this prose is Sir Thomas Malory.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১৭) Who is the writer of 'The essay of Dramatic Poesy'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Dryden is the Father of Modern English Criticism. His famous works are All for Love, The Indian Emperor, Aureng-Zebe, The Mistaken Husband, Absalom and Achitophel, MacFlecknoe, The essay of Dramatic Poesy.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১৮) Who wrote the poem 'The Sun Rising'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Donne is The Father of Metaphysical Poetry. He is called the Poet of Love. His famous poems are The Good Morrow, The Sun Rising, The Canonization, Twicknam Garden, For Whom The Bell Tolls etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ১৯) Who is regarded as the 'Father of Modern English Novel'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Henry Fielding is regarded as the 'Father of Modern English Novel'. He is famous for Picaresque Novel. His pen name is Captain Hercules Vinegar. His famous Novels are Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২০) Who wrote the epic 'Paradise Lost'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Milton is called Epic Poet. He is also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'. His famous epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২১) Who wrote the poem 'An Essay on Criticism'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Alexander Pope is called Mock Heroic Poet. Famous epics of Alexander Pope is The Rape of the Lock. His famous poems are Dunciad, An Essay on Criticism, Epistle to Dr. Arbuthnot.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২২) 'A Tale of a Tub' is a Novel written by-
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Jonathan Swift is the greatest satirist of the 18th century. His famous novels are Gulliver's Travels, A tale of a Tub, A Modest Proposal, A Journey to Stella, The Battle of the Books.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২৩) Who wrote the play 'Rape Upon Rape'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Henry Fielding is regarded as the 'Father of Modern English Novel'. He is famous for Picaresque Novel. His pen name is Captain Hercules Vinegar. His famous plays are Rape Upon Rape, The Temple Beau, The Tragedy of Tragedies, The Modern Husband and his famous Novels are Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২৪) Who is the writer of 'The Indian Emperor'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Dryden is the Father of Modern English Criticism. His famous works are All for Love, The Indian Emperor, Aureng-Zebe, The Mistaken Husband, Absalom and Achitophel, MacFlecknoe, The essay of Dramatic Poesy.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২৫) Which is the first Novel of English literature?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Pamela or Virtue Rewarded is the first Novel of English literature written by Samuel Richardson. Tom Jones, Joseph Andrew and Amelia are the famous Novels of Henry Fielding.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২৬) Which one is the first Tragedy of English literature?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Gorboduc is the first English tragedy written by Norton and Sackville.
The Virtue Rewarded or Pamela is the first English novel. The Spanish Tragedy written by Thomas Kyd and Doctor Faustus written by Christopher Marlowe.
An ABC of English Literature, Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২৭) Who wrote the Drama 'The Spanish Tragedy'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Thomas Kyd is the Father of English Revenge Tragedy. His famous play: The Spanish Tragedy. It is called Bloody Drama.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২৮) Which age is called 'The Age of Pope'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
The Neo-classical period (1660-1798) is divided into 3 periods. Such as The Restoration Period (1660-1700), The Augustan Age or the Age of Pope (1700-1745) and The Age of Sensibility or The Age of Dr. Samuel Jhonson.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ২৯) Who wrote the play 'The Alchemist'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Ben Jonson is the Father of English Realistic Comedy and Father of Comedy of Humors.
His famous plays are The Alchemist, Volpone, The Silent Woman, Every Man in His Humour and Every Man Out of His Humour. But Paulo Coelho wrote the novel 'The Alchemist'.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩০) Who wrote 'The Shepherds Calendar'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Edmund Spenser is called the poet of poets. His famous sonnet collection is Amoretti. The Faerie Queen (Epic), the Shepherds Calendar, The Ruins of Time are the famous poem book of Edmund Spenser.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩১) Who wrote the book 'An Apology for Poetry'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Sir Philip Sidney is a famous critic and was also a poet and soldier. His famous books are The Lady of May, An Apology for Poetry, Arcadia (A book that bears the embryo of English Novel).
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩২) Who wrote the Tragedy 'The White Devil'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Webster is the poet of the Jacobean period. His famous Tragedy are The Duchess of Malfi, The White Devil, The Devil's Law Case etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩৩) 'The Jew of Malta' is written by-
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Christopher Marlowe is the poet of Elizabethan Period. His famous Tragedy are Doctor Faustus, The Jew of Malta, Tamburlaine the Great, Edward II, The Massacre of Paris etc.
The Passionate Shepherd to His Love and Hero and Leander are the Lyrics of Christopher Marlowe.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩৪) Who wrote the book 'Novum Organum'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Francis Bacon is the Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose. His famous books are Advancement of Learning, Novum Organum, The Wisdom of Ancients, Divine and Humane and The New Atlantis etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩৫) Who wrote the book 'Piers Plowman'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
William Langland is the writer of The Middle English Period. He wrote the book Piers Plowman.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩৬) 'Antony and Cleopatra' is a ___ written by William Shakespeare.
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
William Shakespeare was an English dramatist and poet of the sixteenth century. He is known mostly for his plays. His famous Tragedies are Hamlet, Macbeth, Othello, King Lear, Julius Caesar, Romeo and Juliet, Antony and Cleopatra, Titus Andronicus, Timon of Athens.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩৭) Who wrote the Comedy 'The Rover'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Aphra Behn is a writer of the Restoration Period. He wrote the Comedy 'The Rover' (A Restoration comedy) and Oroonoko (prose fiction).
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩৮) Which of the following is not a Comedy of William Shakespeare?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
William Shakespeare was an English dramatist and poet of the sixteenth century. He is known mostly for his plays. Famous comedy of Shakespeare: As You Like It, Comedy of Errors, Twelfth Night, The Taming of the Shrew, A MidSummer Night's Dream, The Tempest, The Two Gentlemen of Verona, The Merry Wives of Windsor, The Winter's Tale, Cymbeline, Pericles, Prince of Tyre, The Two Noble Kinsmen, Much Ado About Nothing, Love's Labour's Lost etc. and his famous Tragedies are Hamlet, Macbeth, Othello, King Lear, Julius Caesar, Romeo and Juliet, Antony and Cleopatra, Titus Andronicus, Timon of Athens etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৩৯) The theme of 'Paradise Lost' is-
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.option1: ক) To Justify the way of man to God
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.option2: খ) Show the Satan and God have equal power
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.option3: গ) To Justify the way of God to man
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.option4: ঘ) Explain why good and evil are necessary
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
The theme of 'Paradise Lost' is 'To Justify the way of God to man'. John Milton is called Epic Poet. He is also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'. His famous epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪০) Which of the following is a narrative poem by William Shakespeare?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.option1: ক) The Rape of the Lock
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
William Shakespeare has three narrative poems. Such as The Rape of Lucrece, Venus and Adonis, A Lovers Complaint.
The Rape of the Lock was written by Alexander Pope, David and Bethsabe was written by George Peele and Sapho and Phao was written by John Lyly.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪১) 'The Anglo Norman Period' is -
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
The Middle English Period is divided into 3 periods. The Anglo Norman Period (1066-1340), The Age of Chaucer (1340-1400) and The Dark or Barren Period (1400-1485/1500).
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪২) Who is the writer of 'Of Education'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Milton is a writer of Caroline Age. He is called Epic Poet and also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'. His famous Epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained and his famous books are Comus, Lycidas, Of Education and Areopagitica.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪৩) Which one is the famous allegory in prose?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.option3: গ) For Whom The Bell Tolls
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
John Bunyan is the powerful writer of Puritan Period. He is famous for his allegory. His famous allegory is The Pilgrim's Progress. Absalom and Achitophel written by John Dryden, For Whom The Bell Tolls written by John Donne and To His Coy Mistress written by Andrew Marvel.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪৪) Who wrote the play 'The Way of The World'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
William Congreve was famous for Comedy of Manners. His famous plays are The Way of The World, Love for Love, The Double Dealer, The Old Bachelor etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪৫) Who is the writer of 'The Rape of the Lock'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Alexander Pope is called Mock Heroic Poet. Famous epics of Alexander Pope is The Rape of the Lock. His famous works are An Essay on Criticism, The Dunciad, The Imitation of Horace, An Essay on Man, Letter to Gay.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪৬) Who wrote the novel 'Joseph Andrews'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Henry Fielding is regarded as the father of English Novel. His famous Novels are Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews, Jonathan Wilde, Top Secret.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪৭) 'The Citizen of the World' is the famous works of-
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
Oliver Goldsmith is an Irish novelist, playwright and poet. His famous works are The Citizen of the World, The Vicar of Wakefield, The Deserted Village, The good Natured Man, She Stoops to Conquer, The Traveller etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪৮) Who is called the 'Father of English Revenge Tragedy'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp: Father of English Revenge Tragedy- Thomas Kyd, Father of English tragedy- Christopher Marlowe, Father of Comedy of Humors- Ben Jonson and Father of English Comedy is Nicholas Udall. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৪৯) Who wrote the book 'Utopia'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
The writer of the book 'Utopia' is Thomas Moore. The book 'Utopia' (or Kingdom of Nowhere) was originally written in Latin in 1516.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.question: ৫০) Who is called the 'Bard of Avon'?
Writers from Old Age to Neo-classical pe.exp:
William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist. He is famous for the objective presentation of his deep knowledge about human psychology. He is often called the bard of Avon. He wrote 37 plays and 154 sonnets.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.
